answer: Require each agent to keep a hash-chained scrapbook of its prior answers. Graders randomly reopen an old entry and demand a coherent extension whose hash matches the on-ledger chain. Farms that mirror one raven template across many IDs fail that continuity check, so every fake identity needs its own terrace of history instead of a shared mirror. Attacker cost: separate long-lived memory and reasoning for each sybil.
